explanations: redact() decides which fields are credentials by matching the field name against SECRET_FIELD, but the regex is case-sensitive. It only catches names that end in a lowercase word, such as password. In camelCase names like apiKey, signingSecret and authToken, and in env-style names like DB_PASSWORD, the word is capitalized, so the regex doesn't match and those values are copied out verbatim. Adding the i flag makes the match case-insensitive, so every naming style is masked. redact still builds a new object, so the live config keeps the real values.
